At least you don't have to sleep on the ground tonight.

As you drift off into dreamy dreamy land, you feel something... Someone... staring at you. You feel the tiny hairs on your neck rise in unison. Goosebumps all over your arms and down your body. You feel cold, yet you're starting to sweat. Good night, says the boogieman.
